summary: 등록된 change-rule family의 native resolve·compile·validator envelope는 통과하지만, 실제 cognitive audit 등록 경로는 공통 validator와 양립하지 않는 control role 및 write-index 계약을 요구하여 pnpm cognitive:verify를 실패시킨다. validator와 v16 authority는 rule-control-start/rule-control-step/rule-control-direction 및 writesStateIndex를 사용하고, audit은 start-value-control/step-magnitude-control/direction-control 및 stateIndex를 하드코딩한다. 숨은 alias emission·중복 target·audit 우회로 닫지 말고 하나의 canonical role/field projection을 먼저 승인해야 한다.
evidenceRefs: command:pnpm exec vitest run packages/templates/src/problem-families/domains/change-relationships/change-rule-construction.test.ts -> 3/3 PASS before audit registration gate
command:pnpm typecheck -> PASS before audit registration gate

choose one canonical write-index field and project it identically from source plan to blueprint constraints, resolved validator, and cognitive audit
register the family through the actual dist-backed cognitive:verify path and prove G1/G7/G8 plus learning-map evidence binding pass

add negative regression fixtures for role alias drift, writesStateIndex/stateIndex drift, missing target constraints, and duplicate hidden aliases

dropping cognitive.change-rule-state-contract or skipping the registered cognitive audit
